author: Kate King
title: Looking for artist for two pieces of character art
content:
I am looking for an artist who has avalibilty right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening?

Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me

update for info I should have put in my initial post: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Will share more info on that privately later as this art is for my new book which is unannounced and I dont want to post too many details publicly. I have no specific style in mind, but would appreciate if you posted an example of your work in the replies.
